features.entryOwner: Each presentation has one generation/lifetime owner and rejects stale async completion.
features.exitOwner: Close, navigation, replacement and interruption converge on idempotent owner cleanup.
features.resourcePolicy: Visible cards may use 2x artwork; alpha masks use 1x art; Special unlock sources are released on cleanup.
features.animationPolicy: Reveal, shine, shadow and CTA motion are finite. While the brown question-mark card is visible and unrevealed, its float and 3D tilt run as paired finite three-second WAAPI cycles that re-arm only after both settle; each settled cycle also starts one bounded burn/glow plus shimmer pulse without repeating haptics. The user-required unlocked New Reward coach starts every three seconds and unlocked tilt repeats as finite screen-local bursts through one replaceable timeout each; tap, reveal, drag, close, replacement, background cleanup or disposal cancels the relevant owners.
features.audioPolicy: Feature cues use their dedicated Journey owners and obey Settings plus interruption cleanup.
features.hapticPolicy: Haptics are interaction/event driven and create no polling or idle owner.
features.visibilityPolicy: Hidden, replaced and disposed presentations stop their owned work and cannot resume through stale callbacks.
features.physicalAcceptance: NEEDS PHYSICAL TEST after bundled delivery for sustained thermal behavior, FPS, touch, audio and visual feel.
